title: The Final Spark
style: Cinematic live-action video still, gritty, low light, handheld feel.

hero.name: You
hero.look: a young person with messy dark hair, dirt on the face, a worn olive canvas jacket over a grey hoodie, dark jeans, scuffed leather boots, grimy hands

rat.name: The rat
rat.look: a brown sewer rat with glossy black eyes, pink ears and long whiskers

old-man.name: The old man
old-man.look: an old man with swept-back grey hair, round wire glasses and a dark wool coat

shadow.name: The shadow
shadow.look: a towering, thin, smoke-black humanoid shadow with long clawed fingers

music.sewer: dark ambient drone, dripping water, low cello, distant metallic hum, tense, slow, instrumental
music.death: mournful solo piano, sparse, reverb, quiet strings swell, instrumental
music.gate: tense pulsing low strings, ticking percussion, suspense, instrumental
music.fog: eerie music box, airy pads, distant bells, hushed, instrumental
music.shadow: dark cinematic trailer score, deep brass, heartbeat drums, rising choir, instrumental

th.mouth: ปากอุโมงค์

title: 下水道
The sewer
story: 你在下水道里醒来。空气恶臭，黑暗深处有水在滴。
You wake in a sewer. The air stinks. Somewhere in the dark, water drips.
question: 你要做什么？
What will you do?

shot.scene: first-person, kneeling on wet cobbles in a dark brick sewer tunnel; a brown sewer rat sits in front of you beside a battered matchbox
shot.motion: the rat twitches its whiskers and stares at you, water drips

title: बंद सिरा
Dead end
story: आगे बंद दीवार है। फर्श पर कुछ काला और घिनौना पसरा है।
A dead end. Something black and foul is smeared across the floor.
question: तुम क्या करोगे?
What will you do?

shot.scene: first-person, your hand holds a lit match up to a bricked-up dead end; black sludge covers the floor
shot.motion: the match flame flickers, the camera looks down at the sludge

title: El pasadizo
The passage
story: Vuelves al pasadizo. La cloaca sigue hacia la oscuridad.
Back in the passage. The sewer runs on into the dark.
question: ¿Hacia dónde irás?
Which way will you go?

shot.scene: first-person, a lit match held out toward a long arched stone sewer passage
shot.motion: slow push forward down the passage, the flame wavers

title: La boue
The sludge
story: Tu touches la boue. La substance dégoûtante te couvre la peau, et tu commences à te sentir gravement malade.
You touch the sludge. The disgusting substance gets all over your skin, and you begin to feel seriously ill.
question: Tu es mort.
You have died.

shot.scene: close-up of your dirty hand touching glowing green sludge on the sewer floor
shot.motion: the fingers sink in, the green glow creeps up the skin, the hand trembles

title: ماء المجاري
Sewer water
story: تصل إلى جزء مغمور من المجاري. الماء قذر.
You reach a flooded stretch. The water is filthy.
question: ماذا ستفعل؟
What will you do?

shot.scene: first-person, wading through ankle-deep filthy sewer water under a stone arch, match in hand
shot.motion: slow wading steps, ripples, the match light dances on the water

title: Fora da água
Out of the water
story: Você sai da água e segue pela cloaca.
You haul yourself out and follow the sewer on.
question: À frente, um portão trancado.
Ahead: a locked gate.

shot.scene: you climb out of the sewer water onto a narrow stone ledge, boots dripping
shot.motion: the hero hauls up onto the ledge and stands

title: Окопная стопа
Trench foot
story: Ты слишком долго стоял в грязной воде. Окопная стопа. Ноги отказывают, и дальше ты не идёшь.
Too long in the filthy water. Trench foot. Your legs give out, and you go no further.
question: Ты умер.
You have died.

shot.scene: close-up of pale, swollen, wrinkled feet beside a pair of soaked boots in the dark
shot.motion: the light dims, a slow fade toward black

title: 門
The gate
story: 錠のかかった鉄の門が道をふさいでいる。
A locked iron gate blocks the way.
question: どうする？
What will you do?

shot.scene: a rusted iron gate blocks the sewer tunnel, lit by a single match; faint light beyond the bars
shot.motion: the camera approaches the gate, the match flame flutters

title: গেট ভাঙো
Break the gate
story: তুমি গেটে কাঁধ দিয়ে ধাক্কা দাও। গেট নড়ে না।
You throw your shoulder against the gate. It doesn't move.
question: এরপর কী করবে?
What will you do next?

shot.scene: your hands grip the bars of the rusted iron gate and pull hard
shot.motion: the hero shakes the gate, rust falls, it does not give

title: Das Schloss knacken
Pick the lock
story: Du fummelst am Schloss herum. Mit bloßen Fingern ist da nichts zu machen.
You work at the lock. Bare fingers aren't enough.
question: Was machst du als Nächstes?
What will you do next?

shot.scene: close-up of your fingers working a bent wire in the gate's rusted padlock by match light
shot.motion: the fingers twist the wire, the lock does not open

title: 열쇠
The key
story: 벽에 묶인 해골의 손에 열쇠가 걸려 있다.
A key hangs from the hand of a skeleton chained to the wall.
question: 그걸로 무엇을 할 거야?
What will you do with it?

shot.scene: first-person, a match lights a skeleton chained to the sewer wall; an old iron key hangs from its ribs
shot.motion: the hand reaches toward the key, smoke curls from the match

title: Kilidi aç
Unlock
story: Anahtar kilide uyar. Kapının ardında kalın bir sis var.
The key fits. Behind the gate, thick fog.
question: Sisin içine girecek misin?
Will you enter the fog?

shot.scene: the old key turns in the padlock; the gate swings open onto thick white fog
shot.motion: the gate creaks open and fog rolls through

title: Sương mù
The fog
story: Bạn bước qua cổng vào sương mù. Gần như không thấy gì phía trước.
You step through the gate into the fog. You can barely see ahead.
question: Bạn sẽ làm gì?
What will you do?

shot.scene: a foggy cobblestone street of an old town at dusk; a tall dark house with a closed door looms ahead
shot.motion: slow walk forward through the fog toward the house

title: Brucia la porta
Burn the door
story: Accosti la fiamma alla porta. Il legno vecchio prende fuoco subito.
You hold the flame to the door. The old wood catches at once.
question: Che cosa succede dopo?
What happens next?

shot.scene: first-person, a lit match held to a weathered wooden front door in the fog
shot.motion: the flame catches and creeps up the door

title: Ketuk
Knock
story: Kamu mengetuk pintu. Seorang lelaki tua membuka, lalu menyuruhmu pergi.
You knock. An old man opens the door and sends you away.
question: Apa yang terjadi selanjutnya?
What happens next?

shot.scene: an old man with grey hair and round glasses opens the door and glares out into the fog
shot.motion: the old man leans out and speaks sharply

lines.speaker: old-man
lines.text: Do you know what time it is? Go away. Nobody comes out of that fog.

title: ٹرک
The truck
story: ایک سفید ٹرک گلی میں کھلا کھڑا ہے۔
A white truck stands open in the street.
question: تم کیا کرو گے؟
What will you do?

shot.scene: a white van stands alone with its door open on a foggy cobbled street
shot.motion: the hero walks up to the van, fog drifts

title: Dentro
Inside
story: Subes a la camioneta. En la oscuridad de la cabina, algo se mueve.
You climb in. In the dark of the cab, something moves.
question: ¿Qué pasa ahora?
What happens next?

shot.scene: the hero, a young person in a worn olive canvas jacket and hood, climbs into the white van
shot.motion: the hero pulls themself inside, the door swings

title: เดินจากไป
Walk away
story: เจ้าหันหลังให้รถบรรทุกแล้วเดินจากไป แต่เงาตามมา
You turn your back on the truck and walk. The shadow follows.
question: เจ้าจะทำอะไร?
What will you do?

choices.say: เต้นกับเงา

shot.scene: the hero walks away down a foggy cobbled street, a match glowing in one hand
shot.motion: the figure walks away and fades into the fog

title: Densi ya kivuli
Shadow dance
story: Unacheza na kivuli. Kitu kinaamka ndani yako, na nguvu ya ajabu inakimbia mwilini mwako. Una nguvu mpya.
You dance with the shadow. Something wakes in you, and a strange power runs through your body. You have new powers.
question: Nguvu zako mpya zimeamka.
Your new powers have awakened.

shot.scene: a towering shadow creature with long claws stands in white fog over the hero's boots on the cobbles
shot.motion: the hero and the shadow move together in a slow dance

title: புதிய சக்திகள்
New powers
story:
அவற்றை சரியாகப் பயன்படுத்த இன்னும் தெரியவில்லை.

உனக்கு 2 புதிய சக்திகள் உள்ளன:

• ஒளியை விழுங்கு
• நிழல் தையல்

You haven't figured out how to use them properly yet.

You have 2 new powers:

• Consume Light
• Shadow Stitch
question: எந்த சக்தியை ஆராய்வாய்?
Which power will you explore?

shot.scene: the hero's open hand, dark smoke curling from the fingers, in a foggy street
shot.motion: the smoke wraps around the hand and pulses

title: కాంతిని మింగు
Consume Light
story: నువ్వు కాంతిని మింగడానికి ప్రయత్నిస్తావు.
You attempt to use Consume Light.
question: తర్వాత ఏం జరుగుతుంది?
What happens next?

shot.scene: first-person, the hand reaches toward candles on a foggy windowsill; the flames bend toward the palm
shot.motion: the candle flames stretch and pour into the hand

title: सावली शिवणे
Shadow Stitch
story: तू सावली शिवण्याचा प्रयत्न करतोस.
You attempt to use Shadow Stitch.
question: पुढे काय होते?
What happens next?

shot.scene: the hero's shadow on the cobbles stretches and stitches itself to the shadow of a lamppost
shot.motion: black threads pull the shadows together

title: ਸ਼ਹਿਰ ਤਬਾਹ ਕਰੋ
Destroy town
story: ਤੂੰ ਸਾਰਾ ਸ਼ਹਿਰ ਤਬਾਹ ਕਰ ਦਿੰਦਾ ਹੈਂ। ਇੱਕ-ਇੱਕ ਕਰਕੇ ਹਰ ਬੱਤੀ ਬੁਝ ਜਾਂਦੀ ਹੈ।
You destroy the whole town. One by one, every light goes out.

shot.scene: the old foggy town burning and falling apart, seen from a hill, shadows pouring through the streets
shot.motion: slow push in as buildings collapse into darkness
